You're referring to the Google Workspace (formerly G Suite) integration with Grokki!

To access your Google Workspace (e.g., Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar) in Grokki, you can use the following functions:

1. `sync_university_portal()`: This function logs into your university's ERP portal and syncs fresh attendance and profile records into Grokki. It also updates your Google Workspace accounts with the latest data.
2. `get_university_profile()`: This function fetches student profile details (name, student ID, program, semester) from the linked university ERP portal.
3. `open_app("Google Workspace")`: This function launches the Google Workspace desktop application. You can use it to access your Gmail, Google Drive, or Google Calendar accounts directly from Grokki.

To use these functions, simply type `sync_university_portal()` or `get_university_profile()` in the Grokki console, and Grokki will handle the rest. If you want to access your Google Workspace accounts, you can use `open_app("Google Workspace")` to launch the application.
